capabilities: open a popup with vault statistics from the ribbon or a command
switch between display styles (simple, aligned, table with averages per note)
treat .txt files as notes when counting
edit settings while the popup is open and see it update
extras: README links to a forum thread for discussion and includes screenshots of the three display styles; the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin disclaimer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for aggregate statistics about the whole vault, such as note counts presented in one popup.
summary: Vault statistics popup that shows counts about the current vault via a ribbon button or a command, with configurable stats and display styles.
